# Add a task

**The finished shape:** `cypress/support/pages/twofactor/` (the page, its elements and actions) and `cypress/e2e/cases/two-factor-form.cy.ts`, the suite's worked example (README.md, "Write a test"). What follows is only what to add.

A task is a sequence a story names as one thing: "sign up", "log in", "check out". It goes in the
page's Tasks class (`DynamicLoadingTasks`), YOURS block **tasks**, and is reached with `execute()`:

```ts
  signUp(email: string): ThanksPage {
    const here = new DynamicLoadingPage();
    here.enter().email(email);
    here.check().terms();
    return here.click().submit();
  }
```

Then the test says `new DynamicLoadingPage().open('2').execute().signUp('pat@example.com').verify().showsThanks();`

Build tasks only from the page's own actions, so every step is logged once and named once. A
task that crosses pages returns the page it ends on.
